title: Sustainable and Ethical Horse Riding in Portugal: Best Regions and How to Choose
seoTitle: Ethical Horse Riding in Portugal: Regions and Tips
seoDescription: Where to go horse riding in Portugal, how to spot an ethical riding centre, the Lusitano's story, and visa tips for Indian travellers planning a trip.
excerpt: Planning a riding holiday in Portugal? Learn about the Lusitano horse, the best regions from the Alentejo to Peneda-Gerês, how to tell an ethical riding centre from a bad one, and what Indian travellers need to know.
